title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API/Console/Dedicated/Private (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting context and intention:
- Quick sync with Eng lead (Jared) to align on short-term priorities across API, Console, Dedicated, Private. Focus on de-risking the November mini-launch and pinning owners for follow-ups.
- Tone: candid, problem-solving, unblockers first.

Top-level agenda (~30m):
1) Quick wins / blockers (5m)
   - Any high-severity incidents or pager noise this week? Jared to call out infra hot spots.
2) Hosted API perf + cost anomaly (8m)
   - Data: 10% increase in p99 latencies for 512-token gen since 11/01. Suspect batching/regression from kernel change.
   - Ask: prioritize rollback vs hotfix. Need ETA for kernel revert and perf run.
3) Console rollout checklist (7m)
   - Console beta: telemetry, feature flags, rollout plan for canary customers. Confirm A/B target and metrics.
   - Need to finalize alert thresholds and dashboard tiles (who owns?).
4) Dedicated capacity onboarding (5m)
   - Customer X onboarding blocked on reserved capacity sizing doc and networking tests. Action: Samir to confirm sizing by 11/14.
5) Private deploys (5m)
   - Air-gapped packaging question: installer/scripts ownership and release cadence. Decide whether to include quantized binaries in initial package.

Notes / scratch thoughts during prep:
- Perf regression: check kernel selector config changes in PR 918 and the canary fleet rollout notes. If rollback costs < 2 dev-days and restores p99, prefer rollback to chasing micro-optimizations.
- Console alerts: want a small set of signal-focused alerts: error rate >0.5% sustained 5m, p95 latency delta >20% baseline, token-cost-per-minute > X. Keep it simple for GA.
- Dedicated sizing: customers often oversubscribe GPU slots; propose a conservative default with documented autoscale headroom.
- Private packaging: include two images: full (with quantized runtimes) and minimal (gcc-free) to simplify legal/kernel compatibility. Might add complexity to support matrix.

Open questions to raise with Jared:
- Do we have a quick metric to prove whether regression is batching-related (e.g., request-size histograms pre/post)?
- Who on infra is comfortable doing a kernel selector revert if we decide to? Last commit author: @samir.
- For Console canary, are we comfortable with 25% traffic for 48h or prefer 10%/96h? Tradeoff: faster feedback vs blast radius.

Action items (with tentative owners + due dates):
- AI-1: Run p99 decomposition (KV cache hit vs kernel time) and share flamegraph by 2025-11-11. Owner: Jared.
- AI-2: Evaluate kernel selector revert plan and estimate dev effort (isolate rollback, test matrix). Owner: Samir. Due: 2025-11-12.
- AI-3: Finalize Console alert thresholds and add 3 dashboard tiles (latency, error-rate, token-cost). Owner: Maya (PM) -> implement with Observability eng if needed. Due: 2025-11-14.
- AI-4: Draft Dedicated sizing recommendation doc for Customer X and run it past Solutions Eng. Owner: Samir. Due: 2025-11-14.
- AI-5: Decide Private packaging approach (single multi-arch image vs two images) and write proposal for release review. Owner: Maya + Eng lead input. Due: 2025-11-17.

Meeting prep checklist (what I need before the 1:1):
- Perf dashboards links + baseline numbers (p50/p95/p99) — grab from QuickSight and paste in the doc.
- Link to kernel PR and canary rollout notes (done in linked_artifacts).
- Console canary plan draft (short bullets) — bring my suggested thresholds.

Follow-up protocol after meeting:
- I'll post a short thread in #product-api summarizing decisions and assign Jira tasks for each action item.
- If rollback is approved, Samir to open an emergency PR with rollback label and tag SRE.

Riskiest assumptions and escalation plan:
- Assumption: perf regression is due to recent kernel selector change. If wrong, we may waste time reverting. Mitigation: require a quick decomposition before full rollback (AI-1).
- Timing: Dedicated onboarding for Customer X tied to legal contract milestone. If sizing slides, escalate to Solutions Eng + CSM.

Random notes / back-of-envelope numbers:
- If p99 stays up, projected cost impact = ~8% increase in token compute for peak hour on hosted tier (~$1.6k/day for current fleet) — back of envelope, needs verification.
- Canary traffic plan: 10% for 72h gives slower signal but easier rollback window. 25% for 48h likely exposes issues faster.

End-of-doc reminders (short):
- Keep the 1:1 focused: unblockers + 1 decision.
- Bring timelines, not just ideas.

Quick draft of Slack summary I'll send after meeting:
"Quick update from PM/Eng 1:1 — agreed to run p99 decomposition (Jared, due 11/11), Samir to scope kernel revert (due 11/12). Console canary thresholds set; Maya to add dashboards by 11/14. Dedicated sizing doc in flight for Customer X (Samir). Private packaging decision by 11/17. Raising tickets and tagging owners now."

-- end scratchpad --
